name: Nek'rosh's Head
summary: In the Wetlands, Nek'rosh's Head proves the Dragonmaw chieftain has fallen. Captain Stoutfist receives it as proof that the threat to Menethil Harbor has been broken.

sections.title: A Decisive Strike
sections.body: The Dragonmaw clan gathers forces and siege weapons across the marshlands, threatening the Alliance port of Menethil Harbor. After the clan's catapults are burned, the port's defense depends on killing Chieftain Nek'rosh. His severed head gives Captain Stoutfist and the Ironforge authorities proof that the warlord's hold over the Wetlands is broken.

faq.answer: Nek'rosh was the chieftain of the Dragonmaw clan remnants in the Wetlands. He directed attacks and war efforts against nearby Alliance territories.

aliases: where do i bring nek'rosh's head
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist wants Nek'rosh's Head as proof that the chieftain has fallen. He commands Menethil Harbor's defense and gives a reward on Ironforge's behalf.

faq.q: Why was Nek'rosh targeted for death?
faq.answer: Nek'rosh directed the Dragonmaw forces threatening Menethil Harbor. The Alliance sought to cripple the clan's presence in the region by destroying its siege weapons and killing its chieftain.

angles.text: For the Alliance, presenting Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist helps secure Menethil Harbor from imminent assault and earns favor with the Kingdom of Ironforge.
As a dwarf, you know the Dragonmaw have plagued Khaz Modan since the Second War. Carrying the chieftain's severed head brings long-awaited justice to the marshlands' defenders.
